name: content-auto
description: AI-powered Figma content automation — Phase 1 local MVP

scripts.build: npm run build -w @content-auto/shared && npm run build -w @content-auto/content && npm run build -w @content-auto/design-engine && npm run build -w @content-auto/ai && npm run build -w @content-auto/storage && npm run build -w @content-auto/workflows && npm run build -w @content-auto/api && npm run build -w @content-auto/dashboard && npm run build -w @content-auto/figma-plugin
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,dash -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @content-auto/shared && npm run build -w @content-auto/content && npm run build -w @content-auto/design-engine && npm run build -w @content-auto/ai && npm run build -w @content-auto/storage && npm run build -w @content-auto/workflows
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @content-auto/shared && npm run typecheck -w @content-auto/content && npm run typecheck -w @content-auto/design-engine && npm run typecheck -w @content-auto/ai && npm run typecheck -w @content-auto/storage && npm run typecheck -w @content-auto/workflows && npm run typecheck -w @content-auto/api && npm run typecheck -w @content-auto/dashboard
